summary: Project now includes authentication/session management fixes and user role administration (assigning admins).
architectural_notes: Introduce role-based access control (RBAC) to support admin assignment and permission checks.
known_issues: Logout function not working properly (session not ending or UI/state not updating).

existing_features.title: Fix the logout flow so that logging out reliably ends the session and the UI/state no longer shows the prior user as authenticated (no stale profile/admin status/reports), using the existing full-cleanup logout approach.

new_feature_requests.summary: Assign user 'sayedbaquar' as an admin (role/permissions update).

Update backend role/permission logic so that the user whose profile.username is exactly "sayedbaquar" is treated as an admin (i.e., their stored UserProfile.role is #admin and AccessControl role is #admin), including when processing pending signups and when an admin attempts to update this user’s role.

projectName: Promote user 'sayedbaquar' to admin and fix logout flow
